\[
\sum_{d=1}^9 d(10-d)=10\sum_{d=1}^9 d-\sum_{d=1}^9 d^2
=10\cdot 45-285=165.
\]
The average absolute difference for one unordered pair is
\[
\frac{165}{\binom{10}{2}}=\frac{165}{45}=\frac{11}{3}.
\]
The average sum is 5 times this:
\[
5\cdot \frac{11}{3}=\frac{55}{3}.
\]
Thus \(p=55,q=3\), so
\[
p+q=58.
\]

\[
\boxed{58}
\]
